accepted_for: Original40 matrix assets with the exact recorded hashes may be consumed by a separately reviewed original40 video scope that rehashes every loaded A on its compute node.
limitations: Matrix bodies and saved moments NPZ bodies remain remote and were not opened in this audit. Their hashes and geometry are recorded by the reviewed successful producer; video runtime must independently check every A payload before using it.

All 6400 original CAL tensor payloads were rehashed and schema/finiteness checked by the reviewed compute-node builder. This review validates that exact successful execution and its provenance, rather than re-running tensor analysis locally.

All diagnostics are fitting-data descriptions from two CAL source images; steps, branches, layers and tokens are repeated observations. These records do not establish held-out generalization, closed-loop candidate video quality, low-rank sufficiency or speedup.

Captured F uses the full native token batch while diagnostic A uses 64 rows. Hidden-space native-BF16 secant fitting is not a theorem of optimal gated output or identical full-batch floating-point behavior.
